title: Umwubatsi w'Inzitizi
intro: Mu bihugu binini, umuntu ukomeye yatangiye ingendo nyinshi, ahabwa ububasha n'ubushobozi bunini. Uyu muntu yahuye n'imiryango itandukanye kandi ahura n'ibibazo bidasanzwe, asiga ikimenyetso kidashira ku mateka no ku kwizera binyuze mu bikorwa bye n'ubwenge bwe, byose hamwe yemera isoko nyakuri y'imbaraga ze.
clues: Nahawe ububasha n'ubushobozi kuri byose, kandi nakurikiye inzira.
Urugendo rwanjye rwanjyanye ahantu izuba rirenga, aho nasanze abantu.
Nahuye n'abaturage batashoboraga kumva neza imvugo, batuye hagati y'imisozi ibiri.
Nasabwe kubaka uruzitiro, atari ukugira ngo ngire inyungu zanjye bwite, ahubwo kugira ngo ngire imbaraga zisenya.
Natangaje ko imbaraga zo kubaka uru rukuta runini zaturutse kuri Allah, kandi ko ruzahoraho kugeza igihe cyasezeranijwe.
Izina ryanjye, rikunze gusobanurwa ngo 'Ufite amahembe abiri,' risobanura ko nageze ku isi cyangwa wenda mu bihe bibiri bitandukanye.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
